subject: Request: one-off pilot extension & credit uplift for Arbor Health
messages:
From: Katie Sullivan <katie@arborhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot next steps

Sean — thanks for the call yesterday. Quick update from our side: the pilot is going well technically, but our analytics team burned through the sandbox allotment faster than expected due to larger sample sizes. We'd like to extend the 6-week pilot by an additional 3 weeks and request an uplift of 200k free tokens so we can finish validation across two more data cohorts.

We are still aligned on the scope in the SOW (attached), but procurement needs an explicit sign-off from Redwood on the extension and credits before they process the addendum. Can you escalate to your execs for a one-time exception? Arbor is targeting a Q3 launch and this pilot will directly feed our procurement decision.

Appreciate quick confirmation — Katie

Attachments: Arbor_POC_SOW_v3.pdf; arbor_usage_snapshot_20260624.csv

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: RE: Pilot next steps — need exec signoff for one-off uplift/extension

Team — forwarding Arbor's ask. TL;DR: they want +3 weeks on the 6-week pilot and 200k free tokens above PLG limits. Context: Arbor is a mid-enterprise prospect (regional health system) with clear path to a 100k ARR run-rate if pilot demonstrates latency/throughput at scale. They spoke with Marissa on onboarding and Marissa included a usage snapshot showing the blowout during cohort tests (attached).

Key asks for exec review:
- One-time credit uplift: 200k free tokens
- Pilot extension: +3 weeks (no additional hosting fees requested)
- Agreement: addendum to SOW (attached) signed by both sides

Questions for leadership: is the one-time uplift +3weeks within acceptable variance for us without a formal deal desk review? If not, want to route to Deal Desk but we need a fast decision — procurement needs confirmation by Monday 06/29 or Arbor will pause evaluation.

Why accelerate: Arbor's procurement lead told Marissa they plan a consolidated vendor decision before end of Q3; missing this timeline likely pushes deal to next year. Estimated upside: $120–150k ARR in year 1, potential upsell to Dedicated in year 2.

Attaching SOW and usage snapshot. Please reply-all with a quick thumbs-up or any conditions.

—Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RE: Pilot next steps — need exec signoff for one-off uplift/extension

Thanks for the summary, Sean. Reviewed the usage snapshot and SOW. I don't want to create a precedent of open-ended credits, but this looks like a narrowly scoped risk with clear commercial upside and a firm procurement deadline. Approve the following one-off exception under these conditions:

1) Credit uplift capped at 200k free tokens and expires at the end of the extended pilot (3 additional weeks). No rollover.
2) Arbor signs the addendum that includes: end date of trial, acceptance criteria (two cohort validations with latency < 120ms p95), and a commit to a commercial review call within 10 business days of pilot completion.
3) Legal must sign off on a one-page addendum (Marissa, please coordinate with Legal).
4) We will record this as a "one-off pilot concession" with a note in the Deal Desk ticket and a follow-up churn/quality checkpoint.

Marissa — please prepare the addendum and loop in Legal. Lauren — update the Deal Desk record with this approval and flags. Sean — communicate the approved terms to Arbor and confirm they accept the conditions before we provision the uplift.

Aditya Rao
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Sullivan <katie@arborhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot next steps

Katie — thanks for the note and for the quick turnaround on the usage details. Good news: Aditya has approved a one-time exception to support Arbor's validation. Conditions are below and reflected in the addendum we'll send for signature: 

- One-time free token uplift: 200,000 tokens, provisioned for the pilot only.
- Pilot extended by 3 weeks; new pilot end date: 2026-08-05.
- Acceptance criteria: validation across two additional cohorts with p95 latency < 120ms, and both cohorts complete by the new end date.
- Credits expire at pilot end; no carry-forward.
- Addendum (one page) to be signed by both parties; Marissa will share the document and Legal will confirm language.
- Redwood requires a commercial review call within 10 business days of pilot completion to review results and discuss next steps.

If Arbor agrees to the above, please reply to this thread and we'll provision the uplift immediately and share the addendum for signature. Looking forward to finishing validation — happy to join any technical calls to expedite.

Best,
